newsitems.title: Borderlands 3 Ultimate Edition получила крупную скидку в Steam - на полном комплекте можно сэкономить 91%
newsitems.contents:
В цифровом магазине Steam стартовала новая скидочная кампания, в рамках которой Borderlands 3 Ultimate Edition можно приобрести с экономией 91% относительно полной стоимости всех входящих в комплект материалов.

Такой процент формируется из скидок на отдельные компоненты издания, после чего Steam дополнительно применяет собственную скидку на покупку всего набора. Поэтому рядом с общей экономией в 91% магазин также может показывать отдельную скидку самого комплекта — в зависимости от региона она составляет около 12–13%.

Borderlands 3 Ultimate Edition объединяет основную игру, Season Pass и Season Pass 2, все крупные сюжетные дополнения, дополнительные режимы и косметический контент. Всего комплект включает 25 позиций и фактически представляет собой наиболее полное издание Borderlands 3 в Steam.

На фоне текущей распродажи итоговая стоимость набора в ряде регионов опустилась ниже предыдущих предложений, хотя сама отображаемая скидка комплекта может выглядеть меньше из-за особенностей расчёта Steam.

Borderlands 3 представляет собой шутер с элементами RPG от Gearbox Software, в котором игроки исследуют разные планеты, собирают огромное количество оружия и проходят кампанию в одиночку или в кооперативе.

Аттракцион невиданной щедрости заканчивается 1 октября.

newsitems.title: Borderlands 4 Free Play Weekend and anniversary sales happening now!
newsitems.author: 2K J
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/c388acc38f1f6a0c22839f3183a126c34dc9a616.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Now's the time to team up with new and veteran Vault Hunters alike for a badass blitz of looter shooter action during the [i]Borderlands 4[/i] Free Play Weekend* and first anniversary sale**, live now![/p][p][/p][p]You and your combat-ready compatriots will be able to battle every bandit, monster, and wild boss fight included in the base game, including free post-launch additions like [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/bounty-pack-3-takedown-circle-of-slaughter-out-now/"]Circle of Slaughter mode[/url][/u]. If you're joining friends who already own [i]Borderlands 4[/i] and a DLC Vault Hunter (including [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/loveless-the-hacker-spotlight/"]Loveless the Hacker[/url][/u]***), they'll still be able to play as their DLC Vault Hunter, but your party will be limited to missions included in the free-to-play base game content. [/p][p][/p][p]If you purchase any edition of [i]Borderlands 4[/i] on the same platform after the Free Play Weekend ends, all your progress and loot will be saved so you can pick up right where you left off. During the Free Play Weekend, you can also take advantage of Cross-Platform Saves, letting you seamlessly continue your Vault Hunters' adventures across the different platforms where you own [i]Borderlands 4 [/i]using your free [u][url="https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-4/news/shift-user-guide/"]SHiFT Account[/url][/u]. Check out the dedicated [u][url="https://support.borderlands.com/hc/articles/52486624854803"]Cross-Platform Saves Support page[/url][/u] for more info.[/p][p]Here's when you'll have free access to [i]Borderlands 4[/i] on Steam: [/p][list][*][p][b]Starts:[/b] September 10, 2026; 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET / 6:00 PM BST / Sept 11, 1:00 AM UTC+8 / 3:00 AM AET[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ends: [/b]September 14, 2026; 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET / 6:00 PM BST / Sept 15, 1:00 AM UTC+8 / 3:00 AM AET[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Whether you're a newcomer to Kairos looking to test-drive the Action Skills and playstyles that are unique to every Vault Hunter, or an experienced [i]Borderlands 4 [/i]player looking to grow your dedicated looter shooter squad, this is the perfect opportunity to take the fight to the oppressive Timekeeper and his Order forces. [i]Borderlands 4[/i] is fully cross-play enabled, so no matter which platforms your friends are playing on, you'll all be able to wreak havoc together.[/p][p][/p][h2][i]Borderlands 4 [/i]Anniversary Sales**[/h2][p]In addition to the Free Play Weekend, [i]Borderlands 4[/i] is celebrating its first year with a multi-platform, limited-time anniversary sale![/p][p][/p][p][b]Steam (offers end September 24 at 10:00 AM PT)[/b][/p][list][*][p]50% off [i]Borderlands 4[/i][/p][/*][*][p]50% off [i]Borderlands 4 Deluxe Edition[/i][/p][/*][*][p]50% off [i]Borderlands 4 Super Deluxe Edition[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Steam players eager to experience even more mayhem-fueled looter shooter action can pick up the [i]Mayhem Bundle[/i], which includes [i]Borderlands [/i]1, 2, 3, and 4—plus [i]Borderlands 4[/i] Story Pack 1: Mad Ellie and the Vaulted of the Damned****. For Vault Hunters with a special love of sequels divisible by two, there's also the [i]Borderlands[/i]² bundle of [i]Borderlands 2 [/i]and [i]Borderlands 4[/i]! If you already own one or more of the games in these bundles on Steam, you'll automatically be granted the best available price using Steam's Complete Your Collection pricing.*****[/p][p][/p][p]Kairos is calling—will you and your friends answer?[/p][p][/p][h2][i]Borderlands [/i]Franchise on Steam[/h2][p]Be sure to Follow the [i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Borderlands"]Borderlands[/url][/u][/i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Borderlands"] Franchise[/url][/u] page on Steam so you don't miss any [i]Borderlands [/i]news or sales! There's always room for more Vault Hunters to join in on the mayhem-fueled looter shooter action.[/p][p][/p][h2][i]Borderlands Dead ECHOs[/i][/h2][p]Ever wonder what happens to all those ECHO logs that don't end up in Vault Hunters' hands? Find out in [i]Borderlands: Dead ECHOs[/i], Gearbox’s first scripted narrative podcast, a darkly comedic drama set in the chaotic [i]Borderlands[/i] universe. In the crazy, cruel badlands of Pandora, two loners forge a connection based on easy money, tenuous trust, and a love for sticking it to well-financed bullies. But what happens when their silly scams start to uncover a full-tilt corporate coup involving cyborg assassins? [/p][p][/p][p][i]Borderlands: Dead ECHOs[/i] follows Watts, a disenchanted DAHL ECHO Operator, who supplements his meager pay by sifting lucrative secrets from undeliverable ECHO logs and selling them to the highest bidder. When Junie, a curious stranger with big ideas, gets him out of a jam, the two strike up an unlikely partnership. As Junie injects a daring Robin Hood twist into Watts’ amateur criminal enterprise, their ECHO-brokering operation draws attention from ruthless mercenaries, violent outlaws, and DAHL’s deadly corporate hit squad lead by power-hungry rogue executive, Vivian Proctor.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Borderlands: Dead ECHOs[/i] is available now via [u][url="https://youtu.be/-nQW5XZqrLY"]YouTube[/url][/u], [u][url="https://open.spotify.com/episode/6ovKqieeltBvf73ie4qv9n?si=8uUIrYSTRjqh1U-oMW31BA"]Spotify[/url][/u], [u][url="https://music.amazon.com/podcasts/efbb55bd-613a-40a0-8df6-746ee1dca094/borderlands-dead-echos"]Amazon[/url][/u], [u][url="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/borderlands-dead-echos/id1888254783"]Apple[/url][/u], [u][url="https://www.iheart.com/podcast/269-borderlands-dead-echos-328483309/"]iHeart Radio[/url][/u], and [u][url="https://www.pandora.com/podcast/borderlands-dead-echos/PC:1001115697"]Pandora[/url][/u]![/p][p][/p][p][i]*Free Play Weekend ends on September 14, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT. After the Free Play Weekend ends, the game must be purchased on the same platform to continue playing and using any add-ons purchased for the game. Progress and Achievements carry over to purchased games. Requires Internet connection and platform account. Terms apply.[/i][/p][p][i]**Discounts based on 2K’s SRP. Digital Only. Steam offers end on September 24 at 10:00 AM PT. Terms apply.[/i][/p][p][i]***Story Pack 2 DLC has two parts: new story content in FL4K and the Last Resort, and a playable Vault Hunter with Loveless the Hacker. Included in the Borderlands 4 Super Deluxe Edition, Vault Hunter Pack, and available for separate purchase. Base game required.[/i][/p][p][i]****Story Pack 1 DLC has two parts: new story content in Mad Ellie and the Vault of the Damned, and a playable Vault Hunter with C4SH the Rogue. Included in the Borderlands 4 Super Deluxe Edition, Vault Hunter Pack, and available for separate purchase. Base game required.[/i][/p][p][i]*****Digital Only. Pricing and availability may vary by region and platform. Subscription-based access may not qualify. See platform store for availability, pricing and terms. Terms apply.[/i][/p][p]

newsitems.title: Introducing the Borderlands: Dead ECHOs narrative podcast
newsitems.author: 2K J
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157740/2a56438d5fd79c4ec0e95fde7d02ebbe9a330926.png"][/img][/p][p]Ever wonder what happens to all those ECHO logs that don't end up in Vault Hunters' hands? Find out in [i]Borderlands: Dead ECHOs[/i], Gearbox’s first scripted narrative podcast, a darkly comedic drama set in the chaotic [i]Borderlands[/i] universe.  [/p][p][/p][p]In the crazy, cruel badlands of Pandora, two loners forge a connection based on easy money, tenuous trust, and a love for sticking it to well-financed bullies. But what happens when their silly scams start to uncover a full-tilt corporate coup involving cyborg assassins? [/p][p][/p][p][i]Borderlands: Dead ECHOs[/i] follows Watts, a disenchanted DAHL ECHO Operator, who supplements his meager pay by sifting lucrative secrets from undeliverable ECHO logs and selling them to the highest bidder. When Junie, a curious stranger with big ideas, gets him out of a jam, the two strike up an unlikely partnership. As Junie injects a daring Robin Hood twist into Watts’ amateur criminal enterprise, their ECHO-brokering operation draws attention from ruthless mercenaries, violent outlaws, and DAHL’s deadly corporate hit squad lead by power-hungry rogue executive, Vivian Proctor.[/p][p][/p][p]The first episode of [i]Borderlands: Dead ECHOs[/i] is available now via [u][url="https://youtu.be/-nQW5XZqrLY"]YouTube[/url][/u], [u][url="https://open.spotify.com/episode/6ovKqieeltBvf73ie4qv9n?si=8uUIrYSTRjqh1U-oMW31BA"]Spotify[/url][/u], [u][url="https://music.amazon.com/podcasts/efbb55bd-613a-40a0-8df6-746ee1dca094/borderlands-dead-echos"]Amazon[/url][/u], [u][url="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/borderlands-dead-echos/id1888254783"]Apple[/url][/u], [u][url="https://www.iheart.com/podcast/269-borderlands-dead-echos-328483309/"]iHeart Radio[/url][/u], and [u][url="https://www.pandora.com/podcast/borderlands-dead-echos/PC:1001115697"]Pandora[/url][/u], with new episodes of this limited series debuting weekly over the next couple of months. Tune in for this throwback to the mayhem-filled days spent on Pandora, then come back each week to see how these new stories unfold! [/p][p]
[/p]
